bio.text: Camille Lilly has represented the 78th District in the Illinois House since April 2010.
According to the legislature's biography, Lilly is a lifelong resident of Chicago's Greater West Side and graduated from Oak Park-River Forest High School.
Lilly holds a bachelor's degree in management from Drake University, a master's degree in healthcare administration from Oklahoma University, and a Kellogg Executive MBA from Northwestern University.
